subject: SIG: request for SCIM snapshot + SAML assertion examples
messages:
From: Joanna Park <joanna.park@healthspan.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthSpan InfoSec <security@healthspan.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: SCIM + SAML samples for review

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG intake for the prospective contract we need a few artifacts to validate provisioning and access controls: a recent SCIM snapshot (or delta) showing user->group assignments, an RBAC/role mapping spreadsheet that shows how platform roles map to HealthSpan roles, and two example SAML assertion payloads (one for an interactive user and one for a service account) with timestamps and NameID formats.

If possible we need redacted artifacts by EOD Sept 3 PST. We will treat these as confidential — if you have an NDA pointer, please include.

Specific asks: 
- SCIM snapshot (CSV or JSON) with attribute columns: externalId, userName, active, groups
- Role mapping (xlsx) with columns: redwood_role, hs_equivalent, privileges
- SAML assertion samples (txt) showing attribute statements and audience

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if there are edge cases.

Joanna Park
Senior InfoSec Analyst
HealthSpan Medical

---

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Joanna Park <joanna.park@healthspan.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: SCIM + SAML samples for review

Joanna — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three items; planning notes below.

Delivery plan:
- Naomi will export a redacted SCIM snapshot (CSV) containing the columns you requested. We will redact email addresses and user ids where appropriate.
- I will attach an RBAC mapping draft (xlsx) showing mapping from our platform roles to common HealthSpan roles.
- Irene will pull two SAML assertions from our staging logs and scrub any PII. We will replace specific identifiers with placeholders but preserve structure and NameID formats.

Target delivery: EOD PT Friday (2027-09-03). If you need earlier, tell me which piece to prioritize and we will expedite.

Attached for your visibility (stubs below) — final files will be uploaded to a shared drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-share/1a2b3c-scim-delivery

Attachments: scim-snapshot-sample.csv (stub), role-mapping-draft.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: SIG: SCIM + SAML samples for review

Looping you both in — HealthSpan (Joanna) needs a redacted SCIM snapshot, role mapping draft, and two SAML assertion examples by EOD Fri 9/3 PT. Quick owners & asks: 

Naomi — can you run the SCIM export for the tenant "healthspan-prod" from 2027-08-30 and produce a CSV with columns externalId,userName,active,groups? Redact the userName and externalId using the pattern user_redacted_###. Put it in the drive link above and mark it as scim-snapshot-sample.csv. Let me know if the export takes longer than 2 hours.

Irene — can you pull one interactive-user assertion and one service-account assertion from staging logs (timestamps around 2027-08-30 08:00-12:00 UTC)? We need to keep audience, issuer, NameID format, and attribute statements intact but redact PII. Output as plain text files; name as saml-assertion-sample.txt. If you run into encryption-protected logs, ping me — we can pull a debug dump from the instance.

I'll finalize the role mapping draft (attached) and do a quick review before upload. If either of you foresee any compliance blockers (PHI/PII concerns) flag here and we'll escalate to Legal.

Thanks — ETA 9/3 EOD PT.

Mateo

---

From: Joanna Park <joanna.park@healthspan.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthSpan InfoSec <security@healthspan.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: SCIM + SAML samples for review

Mateo — appreciate the quick turnaround and the plan. A couple small clarifications before you upload: 

1) For the SAML assertion samples, could you please ensure one example uses NameID format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent" and the other uses the transient format? That helps our parser tests.
2) When redacting, please preserve the attribute names and types (e.g., email, groups) but you can mask values.
3) We prefer the role-mapping file as an XLSX with a brief notes sheet describing any custom role behaviors.

If possible, add a short README (README.txt) in the drive folder that lists the files and the redaction approach used. No NDA necessary at this stage — we'll keep this internal.

Best,
Joanna

On Thu, Sep 2, 2027 at 09:10 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Uploaded initial drafts to the shared drive: scim-snapshot-sample.csv, role-mapping-draft.xlsx, saml-assertion-sample.txt (redacted). See README.txt for notes.
